<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>Cinema HQ - #1 Media Application</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="description" content="Cinema HQ - The number one application to watch all your favourite movies, TV-shows, Live TV, Anime, play retro games and more." />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Cinema HQ" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="Cinema HQ - The number one application to watch all your favourite movies and tv-shows." />
  <meta property="og:url" content="https://cinemahq.app" />
  <meta property="og:site_name" content="Cinema HQ" />
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://www.cinemahq.app/public/SectionImages/mainlogo.png" />
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <link rel="icon" href="favicon.png" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@300;400;500;700&family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    /* ── Reset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size: 16px; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      background-color: #0f1117;
      color: #e2e8f0;
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    ul { list-style: none; }

    /* ── Design tokens ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    :root {
      --bg-base:    #0f1117;
      --bg-surface: #181c24;
      --bg-card:    #1e2330;
      --bg-elevated:#252b38;
      --border:     rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      --blue:       #4f8ef7;
      --blue-dark:  #3a72d8;
      --blue-glow:  rgba(79,142,247,0.18);
      --green:      #4caf84;
      --amber:      #f5a623;
      --text-primary:   #e2e8f0;
      --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
      --text-muted:     #64748b;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }

    /* ── Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
    .section { padding: 80px 0; }
    .section-sm { padding: 56px 0; }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--blue);
      background: var(--blue-glow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.25);
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.25;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-desc {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .divider {
      border: none;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .badge-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green);
    }

    /* ── Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(79,142,247,0.35);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(79,142,247,0.45); }
    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: #2d3545; }
    .btn-lg { padding: 15px 30px; font-size: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
    .btn-discord {
      background: #5865F2;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .btn-discord:hover { background: #4752c4; }
    .btn-github {
      background: #24292e;
      color: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    }
    .btn-github:hover { background: #373e47; }
    .btn-sponsor {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ea4aaa, #c6459a);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .btn-sponsor:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c6459a, #a8347e); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── Card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .card:hover { border-color: rgba(79,142,247,0.3); }
    .card-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--blue-glow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.25);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }
    .card-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .card-body { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── Navbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .navbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(15,17,23,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .navbar-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .navbar-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .navbar-logo {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .navbar-name {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .navbar-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .nav-link {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-elevated); }
    .navbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }

    /* mobile nav drawer */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 200;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-nav-drawer {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      width: min(80vw, 320px);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .mobile-nav-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mobile-nav-close {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .mobile-nav a {
      display: block;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .mobile-nav a:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .mobile-nav-overlay { flex: 1; }

    /* ── Hero ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      padding: 96px 0 80px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -60px; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 800px; height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(79,142,247,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-title span { color: var(--blue); }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .hero-codes {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }
    .code-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      font-size: 0.87rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .code-chip strong {
      font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .hero-social {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .hero-screenshot {
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-screenshot-wrap {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .hero-screenshot-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }
    .hero-screenshot-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 20px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: rgba(15,17,23,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ── Features grid ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    /* ── App screenshots strip ─────────────────────────────────── */
    .screenshots-section {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 64px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .screenshots-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .screenshots-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: var(--bg-card);
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
    .screenshot-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

    /* ── Services section ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .services-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }
    .service-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .service-card:hover { border-color: rgba(79,142,247,0.35); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .service-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .service-name { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .service-status {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .service-desc { font-size: 0.87rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.55; }
    .service-note {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--amber);
      background: rgba(245,166,35,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }

    /* ── Codes section ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .codes-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }
    .code-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px;
    }
    .code-card-label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .code-value {
      font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 2.4rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .code-hint { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }

    /* ── Honeygain section ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .honeygain-section {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .honeygain-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .honeygain-logo-wrap {
      width: 80px; height: 80px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .honeygain-logo-wrap img { width: 60px; height: 60px; object-fit: contain; }
    .hg-title { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .hg-body { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 20px; max-width: 640px; }
    .hg-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hg-list li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .hg-list li::before {
      content: '✓';
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    /* ── Install section ────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .install-section { text-align: center; }
    .install-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
      margin: 48px 0;
      counter-reset: step;
    }
    .step-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px 24px;
      position: relative;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .step-num {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--blue);
      opacity: 0.3;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .step-title { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .step-body { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.55; }
    .step-code {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--blue);
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    /* ── Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 48px 0 32px;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: 0.87rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 12px;
      max-width: 240px;
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 0.87rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copy { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .footer-socials { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

    /* ── Responsive ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 48px;
      }
      .hero-screenshot { order: -1; }
      .hero-title { font-size: 2rem; }
      .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .honeygain-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .honeygain-logo-wrap { width: 64px; height: 64px; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .navbar-links, .navbar-actions { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .section { padding: 56px 0; }
      .hero { padding: 64px 0 48px; }
      .hero-title { font-size: 1.7rem; }
      .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
      .hero-actions .btn { width: 100%; }
      .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; }
      .btn-lg { padding: 14px 24px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
      .codes-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 380px) {
      .codes-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <style>
    /* ── Reset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size: 16px; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      background-color: #0f1117;
      color: #e2e8f0;
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    ul { list-style: none; }

    /* ── Design tokens ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
    :root {
      --bg-base:    #0f1117;
      --bg-surface: #181c24;
      --bg-card:    #1e2330;
      --bg-elevated:#252b38;
      --border:     rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      --blue:       #4f8ef7;
      --blue-dark:  #3a72d8;
      --blue-glow:  rgba(79,142,247,0.18);
      --green:      #4caf84;
      --amber:      #f5a623;
      --text-primary:   #e2e8f0;
      --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
      --text-muted:     #64748b;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }

    /* ── Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
    .section { padding: 80px 0; }
    .section-sm { padding: 56px 0; }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--blue);
      background: var(--blue-glow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.25);
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.25;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-desc {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .divider {
      border: none;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .badge-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green);
    }

    /* ── Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(79,142,247,0.35);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(79,142,247,0.45); }
    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: #2d3545; }
    .btn-lg { padding: 15px 30px; font-size: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
    .btn-discord {
      background: #5865F2;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .btn-discord:hover { background: #4752c4; }
    .btn-github {
      background: #24292e;
      color: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    }
    .btn-github:hover { background: #373e47; }
    .btn-sponsor {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ea4aaa, #c6459a);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .btn-sponsor:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c6459a, #a8347e); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── Card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .card:hover { border-color: rgba(79,142,247,0.3); }
    .card-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--blue-glow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.25);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }
    .card-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .card-body { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── Navbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .navbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(15,17,23,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .navbar-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .navbar-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .navbar-logo {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .navbar-name {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .navbar-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .nav-link {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-elevated); }
    .navbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }

    /* mobile nav drawer */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 200;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-nav-drawer {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      width: min(80vw, 320px);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);

    /* ── Hero ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {

      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
